verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only portal menu labels (File: New Business, Order: Certificate of Good Standing), account-mechanics notes (password reset, transaction history, payment), and Department of Revenue link titles. None of it shows plain-language, step-by-step explainers that walk a non-lawyer founder through a filing task. The main sos.state.mn.us site, where such guides might live, was bot-walled and not observed, so absence of evidence for this applicable capability yields none.
